newsitem.title: USA: Ocean Energy says raises note tender price.
newsitem.headline: Ocean Energy says raises note tender price.

text.p: Ocean Energy Inc said on Monday it has increased the offer price and extended the consent date of its outstanding tender offer and consent solicitation for all of its outstanding 13-1/2 percent senior notes due 2004.
The company said it has decreased the fixed spread over the applicable reference security for purposes of calculating the tender offer consideration to 50 basis points.

In addition, to receive a consent payment, holders must tender their notes and provide their consents to the proposed amendments at any time on or prior to midnight EDT on the business day following the public announcement of the consent achievement date.

The company extended the consent achievement date to the later of either July 14, if on such date it has received the requisite consents, or the first date thereafter that it shall have first received the requisite consents.
